name: kanon_prophets
description: Route a biblical text query to the Prophetic Books: Isaiah, Jeremiah, Lamentations, Ezekiel, Daniel, Hosea, Joel, Amos, Obadiah, Jonah, Micah, Nahum, Habakkuk, Zephaniah, Haggai, Zechariah, Malachi. Use when the query names one of these seventeen books, or asks about prophetic judgment and restoration, the suffering servant, Emmanuel and the virgin birth prophecy, the new covenant, the potter's house, new hearts of stone and flesh, the valley of dry bones, the fiery furnace, the lion's den, Daniel's visions or the seventy weeks, the day of the Lord, locusts, social justice and Amos, Jonah and the great fish, Nineveh, Bethlehem Ephrathah, the writing on the wall, or the messenger of Malachi. Two canon traps: Daniel and Lamentations sit in this division under this ordering, and 'Zechariah' the prophet is this skill while 'Zechariah son of Jehoiada' in 2 Chronicles is not. Do not use for Genesis through Deuteronomy (use kanon_law), Joshua through Esther (use kanon_history), Job through Song of Solomon (use kanon_wisdom), or Matthew onward (use kanon_new_testament).

book.description: Target prophetic book. Covers both major and minor prophets plus Lamentations and Daniel. A book outside this enum belongs to a different skill.

chapter.description: Target chapter number, 1-indexed, in the numbering of the named book. Ranges span Obadiah's single chapter up to Isaiah's 66 and Jeremiah's 52, and include Ezekiel 1-48, Daniel 1-12 and Zechariah 1-14.

query.description: The user's search intent in their own words, stripped of the book and chapter reference. Keep prophetic or thematic wording. Example: for 'Isaiah 53 who is the suffering servant', pass 'identity of the suffering servant'.
